title: BODY / FIELD
purpose: Private-local embodied state instrument over shared body plans: fast NOW capture, cyclic PULSE replay, bounded TEST loops, bounded calibration CAMPAIGNs and typed BODY↔HOUSE context without diagnostic or causal overclaim.
kernel: OBJECT -> ADDRESS -> OBSERVE -> PROJECT -> TEST -> RETURN -> FADE

authority_split.body: self-observation, body address, locally retained state history and bounded calibration campaign state
authority_split.care: episode / clinician-vet handoff and care-course coordination
authority_split.house: environment/device state authority remains private Home Assistant / HOUSEBUS
authority_split.env0: typed relation bridge between BODY observation and WORLD/HOUSE context

projections.NOW: one-gesture valence/activation + compact signals + optional body address/context
projections.PULSE: same events on cyclic day/time field plus sample-gated same-return or next-return<=12h descriptive factor contrasts
projections.TEST: one explicit intervention/action against one selected outcome with before/after return
projections.CAMPAIGN: bounded calibration state over selected streams with declared evidence gate, burden budget, derivedness cap and explicit FADE back to a lower monitoring aperture
projections.BRIDGE: same-origin localStorage BODY↔HOUSE context envelopes; no public personal state

evidence_laws: ACTIVE SELF-REPORT and PASSIVE/ENVIRONMENT CONTEXT remain source-distinct
BODY EVENT != CARE CASE until explicit import
FADE is an explicit reduction of monitoring aperture, not a claim that a question is permanently solved

campaign.runtime_law: Only declared transitions advance state. Evidence gates report sufficiency only. Burden budgets can suppress further prompting. RETURN requires an explicit disposition. FADE lowers aperture according to the campaign declaration.
campaign.authority: No diagnostic, prescription, medication-change or autonomous treatment authority.

exits.care: /care/ via explicit browser-local handoff; CARE requires user import into current case

core.role: pure state/factor/contrast/test/address plus campaign transition/evidence/burden/derivedness functions reusable by other clients
